description: The same weakness on the second language, where the algorithm and the data arrive in one call. A key derivation function takes the salt as an argument, so there is somewhere for it to go; a plain digest has nowhere. The composed route is a stated miss rather than a safe line: what was added there is a site-wide pepper, which is not a per-account salt.

expected.note: low because the password passes through .encode(), a method call the frontend resolves only as probable
